::: {#exm-web-matrix}
#### The adjacency matrix of a directed graph

With its vertices in the order home, about, blog, contact,
the directed graph of @exm-web-links has the adjacency matrix (@def-adjacency-matrix)

$$
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & 1 & 1 & 0
\\
0 & 0 & 0 & 1
\\
1 & 0 & 1 & 1
\\
1 & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

The entry in row 1 and column 3 is 1, since home links to blog,
and so is the entry in row 3 and column 1, since blog links to home.
The entry in row 2 and column 1 is 0, since about does not link to home, although home links to about.
The 1 in row 3 and column 3 is the loop at blog.
This is the matrix of the relation "links to" (@def-relation-matrix, @rem-relation-digraph-graph).

:::
